sip-wine-food v1.0.1 Changelog

- Skill has been renamed and restructured for new data source with stricter access rules.
- Now requires all restaurant, wine, and dish queries to be performed via the MCP endpoint: https://mcp.sipsiip.com/api/sippai only.
- Supports searching Sippai partner restaurants, then fetching both bottle/glass wine menus as well as menu-sorted dishes for pairing suggestions.
- User selection is required if multiple restaurants match; only tool-returned data may be shown—never fabricate items or prices.
- All old HTTP endpoints, tool names, and workflows from previous versions are replaced in favor of the new MCP-only implementation with updated rules and fields.

- Initial release of sip-glass-wine skill for querying real-time by-the-glass wine lists and prices at sipsiip partner venues.
- Supports searching wine lists via keywords (restaurant/bar/wine shop names, addresses) without needing an API key.
- Ensures accuracy by requiring user selection when multiple venue matches are found; prohibits guessing, fabricating prices, or making assumptions.
- Clearly displays available wines by name, volume, and price; notifies user if data is missing or unavailable.
- Uses real-time data synchronized from smart wine dispensers in participating venues.
